A '''Ghoul''' is found in the final room of the dungeon underneath [[Paterdomus]], having somehow managed to bypass the [[holy barrier]]. If [[Priest in Peril]] is not completed, it must be killed once in order to access [[Morytania]].

Killing it is also a requirement to use [[Portal Chamber|Kharyrll house portals]], the ability to teleport to the sinkholes at the [[Canifis]] area, and the [[Everlight Dig Site]].
